name: automation-builder
description: Asks what tools you use and what outcome you want, then designs one safe automation around your process.

interface.shortDescription: Design one safe automation around the tools you already use
interface.longDescription: Asks what tools you actually use and what outcome you want, verifies what those tools can really do against their current documentation, and designs one automation around your process. Version one reads bounded information, prepares a private review only you see, and stops until a real test run comes back clean.
defaultPrompt: Help me automate something I do every week.
What would you need to know to automate my follow-ups?
